Referential integrity.qtext: Explain the meaning of the database term referential integrity.

SQL.ms: SQL is a programming language for creating, accessing and manipulating databases / It provides commands to create tables and to insert, search, update, delete records / It consists of a large set of commands, each with its own syntax

Turing test.ms: A test to determine if a machine’s behaviour is indistinguishable from a human’s response / The test involves a player, a human and a machine / The player does not know which is the human and which is the machine / The player asks questions of the human and the machine … and tries to discover which is the human (3 × [1])
Turing test.qtext: Explain what is meant by the Turing test.
